frame_policy: Upper midpoint of the 26 provided neutral mesh frames; fixed before model inference
camera_policy: Color cameras near head-local +Z and an oblique side view, selected from calibration before model inference; no residual-based selection
alignment: One positive uniform similarity to fixed front-photo rays on tracked triangle surface; no ICP, local warp or coefficient fit
metric: Source face vertices to tracked mesh triangle surface, one direction; not raw scan ground truth or bidirectional coverage
physical_units: Use native tracked units and fixed outer-eye span; no unverified millimetre claim
limitations: Tracked geometry has reconstruction/tracking error; not an unprocessed independent scan
Neutral segment label is a capture instruction, not proof of perfect expression neutrality
One subject, one fixed frame and two cameras; no model-wide certificate
Detector-derived registration anchors are not independently annotated landmarks
Surface has eye/mouth holes; anchor ray misses must fail, not use nearest vertices
Reported identity evaluation neutralizes only a separate SMIRK diagnostic copy; original predictions remain unchanged
